speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: asked the Minister for National Development when does the Government expect to conclude its review of the Community Advisory Panel on Neighbourhood Noise's recommendation for a quantitative noise threshold and introduce legislation to respond and enforce against unacceptable neighbourhood noise levels.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Just two very quick supplementary questions for the Senior Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: And second, I understand from the Committee of Supply debate earlier this year that the pilot team of dedicated personnel for the pilot scheme was supposed to be in place by the end of this year.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: I was just wondering if that is still on track and what the expected duration for the pilot phase will be before the whole programme is rolled out islandwide.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: The first is: whether or not the six key recommendations of the Community Advisory Panel report will be taken up, is that the plan?

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: And second, in terms of the pilot team of dedicated personnel that was supposed to be rolled out by the end of this year to deal with the egregious cases, I am just wondering what is the expected duration for the pilot phase and also, when should we expect the full implementation of the programme?
